Classrooms are below decent sometimes it's as the infrastructure and all the benches tables fans etc are really old .

Crowd(3/5): Everyone will have different crowd preferences and they can get their type of crowd for being frnds as all types of people are in the college as for the seniors my personal experience was that as long as you are profitable to them they are good to you once your purpose is done they won't recognise you and all so don't look up to them if you want to socialize be a volunteer during ganpati festival and all and then you can be with them if you want .

Boards perspective (4/5): Teachers manage your marks in the internals help you during practicals and if you manage to stay in their good looks you'll get out of marks in the internals just attend the practicals and clear all the submissions on time

Overall(3/5): a decent college if you want stress free attendance and internals during boards etc but if you want to live your college life like in the movies plzzz don't come in this college

Feedback for Aspiring Students:

I want to share my experience with SN Educator Classes to help others make an informed decision regarding SET/NET/JRF preparation:

1. Lack of Study Materials: No books or resources were provided for either Paper 1 or Paper 2. I didn't received any soft copies either.

2. Irregular Classes: Lectures are only conducted on Sundays, and there is no consistent schedule.

3. No Refund Policy: Refunds are not considered, even if services fall short of expectations.

4. Owner’s Behavior: Mrs. Nisha, the owner, has been rude in her interactions and often refers to call recordings and chat conversations, creating a tense and uncomfortable environment for students.

Although the faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, the overall experience left me feeling disheartened and undervalued. As an Assistant Professor myself, I am not here to defame anyone’s reputation, but I genuinely understand the value of time and hard-earned money. My intention is to share my honest experience to help others make a well-informed decision.
